title: Validate nested records and collection entries
goal: Discover a form's complete editable graph, retain deliberate SkipValidation boundaries and remove the old experimental-attribute suppression when moving to .NET 11.

selectionNotes: Generated Microsoft.Extensions.Validation metadata is required for nested objects and collections.
Stable .NET 11 attributes; the .NET 10 comparison explicitly uses experimental attributes with local ASP0029 suppression.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: The primary route uses .NET 11 framework contracts.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Build against .NET 11 reference assemblies; exact RC2 is evidence, not an exact installation requirement.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Declared canonical sample language mode; preview language syntax is not required.

packageAssets: Microsoft.Extensions.Validation runtime/reference assemblies and ValidationsGenerator from Microsoft.AspNetCore.App.Ref; SDK-aligned Microsoft.AspNetCore.App.Internal.Assets browser files. No redundant PackageReference in the measured SDK.
platforms: ASP.NET Core server; executed on Windows x64 with Chromium 152. No native platform/workload requirement.
renderingModes: Blazor static SSR; enhanced and plain form posts
prerequisites: Use Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web with net11.0, C# 15.0, nullable and implicit usings enabled. The measured SDK supplies Microsoft.Extensions.Validation assemblies and ValidationsGenerator from Microsoft.AspNetCore.App.Ref, plus aligned Microsoft.AspNetCore.App.Internal.Assets browser files. A redundant PackageReference produced NU1510; none is needed here. Keep matching generator/runtime/browser assets when using another toolset.
constraints: Generated Microsoft.Extensions.Validation metadata is required for nested objects and collections.
Stable .NET 11 attributes; the .NET 10 comparison explicitly uses experimental attributes with local ASP0029 suppression.
No arbitrary cross-assembly, trimming/AOT, interactive transition or conditional older-target package route is claimed.
stabilityLimitations: Stable .NET 11 contracts verified on RC2 artifacts; GA reconciliation pending. Older public generator attributes are experimental in the .NET 10 comparison only.

evidence.scope: Actual Web SDK compilation with framework validation generator and locked aligned browser assets. Separate real browser/HTTP execution: docs/verification/PIN-772-773.md. Compilation output alone is not runtime proof.
